display.purpose: Route titles and rare high-level CP statements.

body.purpose: Readable operational copy, forms, tables, and labels.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, dialogs, and active drag surfaces.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dependable action for completing an operational task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #171717; color: #fff; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #414141; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7040d8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: A CP coral action reserved for meaningful emphasis or urgency.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #e85d3f; color: #fff; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #b83e2b; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7040d8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A quiet paper surface for grouped operational information.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fff; color: #171717; border: 1px solid #d9d9d4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 18px/1.3 'Sora', sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #4a4a4a; font: 400 16px/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A calm, clearly labelled field for operational input.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #fff; color: #171717; border: 1px solid #d9d9d4; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 16px/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7040d8; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #7040d8; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Persistent ink navigation with an unmistakable current location.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #171717; padding: 16px 8px; } .ds-nav a { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #d9d9d4; font: 500 14px/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #2b2b2b; color: #fff; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: #e85d3f; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Bring the public identity of Collective Perspectives into an internal tool without turning operations into a campaign page. Use ink, paper, disciplined spacing, direct actions, and human agency as the visual foundation. Coral carries CP's expressive energy; purple, teal, and mustard remain semantic signals.
keyCharacteristics: Coral as a scarce signature accent

rules.name: The Scarcity of Color Rule
rules.body: A screen should read clearly in grayscale. Accent color marks action, state, or CP emphasis; it does not fill every component.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If spacing, a divider, or a tonal surface can establish hierarchy, prefer it over a shadow.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Sora for hierarchy and DM Sans for the operational body. Do not introduce another display face for a route or feature.

dos: Do use ink, paper, and coral as the primary visual relationship.
Do let typography, dividers, and whitespace carry hierarchy.
Do make status understandable through text, icon, and color together.
Do provide visible focus, keyboard access, and reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't use a purple/coral gradient as the default hero, button, or metric treatment.
Don't build every section from identical icon-tile stat cards.
Don't use decorative pulse, blur, or hover movement that does not communicate state.
Don't make the internal tool read like a public marketing landing page.
